commands: lsuser -a shell account_locked login rlogin ALL
blurb: This check confirms that login-capable accounts on a Virtual I/O Server use the ioscli restricted shell. IBM VIOS lsuser documents those accounts as using the rksh shell; a ksh, sh, bash, or oem_setup_env login shell skips that wrapper and is the persistent form of oem_setup_env unrestricted AIX access. On a plain AIX partition the restricted-shell model does not apply.
